run_test_basic: run the test_basic function to verify C/C++ header dependency scanning and implicit dependencies in Boost.Build
run_test_scanned_includes_with_absolute_: run the test_scanned_includes_with_absolute_paths function to verify absolute path include scanning on Windows
test_boostbuild_dependency_scanning: test that Boost.Build correctly scans #include directives and rebuilds targets when headers change
test_implicit_dependency_feature: test the implicit-dependency feature so generated headers from one target are visible to another
test_generated_header_dependencies: test that touching a .foo source file triggers recompilation of targets depending on generated headers
